option_relations.rationale: The option 'Chondroma' directly matches the leaf label 'Chondroma' (B1.1), indicating a direct equivalence between the two.
The option 'Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone' directly matches the leaf label 'Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone' (B2.1), indicating a direct equivalence between the two.

The option 'Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the mastoid with facial nerve involvement' is a subtype of 'Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone' (B2.1) and is closely related to 'Low-grade Chondrosarcoma of the Temporal Bone with Facial Nerve Involvement' (B4.3).
The option 'Benign chondroma' directly matches the leaf label 'Chondroma' (B1.1), indicating a direct equivalence between the two, with 'benign' being an implicit characteristic of chondroma.
